title: Value Accounting Rule: Expiry and Voiding of Value on Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
**Rule.** Only promotional value expires. A Northgate Promotional Gift Card can be used through its issue date plus its type's validity period in calendar days, 45 calendar days, the last usable day being recorded as the card's expiration date, and any value left after that day lapses on the following day. Where the type deducts promotional value on the return of the earning purchase and the purchase that earned the promotional card is returned, any unused promotional value is voided as a promotional clawback, and value already spent is deducted from the return's refund. Value loaded through a fraudulent transaction is voided as a fraudulent load. Purchased, return and bulk cards in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program never expire.

## The usable period of a Northgate Promotional Gift Card

- **Clock start.** The card's issue date.
- **Count.** 45 calendar days are added to the issue date; every calendar day counts.
- **Last usable day.** The issue date plus 45 calendar days, recorded as the expiration date. The card can still be spent on that day.
- **Lapse.** Value left after the expiration date lapses on the following day, and the card becomes expired.

| Hypothetical issue date | Expiration date (last usable day) | Spending on 15 April | Spending on 16 April |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 April | allowed, the last usable day | not allowed; remaining value lapses on 16 April |

The count runs 30 days from 1 March to 31 March and 15 more to 15 April, 45 calendar days in all.

## Return of the purchase that earned a promotional card

| Hypothetical position at the return | Unused promotional value | Spent promotional value |
|---|---|---|
| card of 20.00 never used | 20.00 voided as a promotional clawback | none, nothing deducted |
| card of 20.00 with 15.00 spent | 5.00 voided as a promotional clawback | 15.00 deducted from the return's refund |
| card of 20.00 fully spent | none | 20.00 deducted from the return's refund |

## Other voids and non-expiry

- Value loaded through a fraudulent transaction is removed from the card as a fraudulent load.
- A Northgate Gift Card, Northgate eGift Card, Northgate Merchandise Return Card, Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card or Northgate Reloadable Gift Card never expires.
